description: trims surrounding whitespace from every bounded CSV cell using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded csv trim cells result before an agent hands structured data or a batch plan to a downstream tool with a stricter contract. Returns the bounded transformation or validation finding with counts, normalized values, and a versioned result contract for CSV Trim Cells as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Processes bounded caller-supplied data in memory only; it performs no file fetch, database write, code execution, or retention.

text.description: Text supplied to CSV Trim Cells; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

name: util_csv_trim_cells
